name: linkedin-mcp-tools

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Report server version, browser/login status, and capabilities.

tools.name: health_check
tools.description: Deep health check: cookie login state, a LIVE Voyager probe (confirms the API actually answers, not just that a cookie exists), and today's safety-budget headroom (per-action used/cap/remaining + pending invites).

tools.name: close_session
tools.description: Close Chrome while retaining this runtime’s profile ownership. Stop the server to release the profile.

tools.name: get_my_profile
tools.description: Get the authenticated user's own LinkedIn profile (experience, education, headline, summary).

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Get a LinkedIn profile by public identifier (the slug in the profile URL, e.g. "satyanadella").

username.description: LinkedIn public identifier / vanity slug, e.g. "williamhgates"

tools.name: get_feed
tools.description: Get recent posts from your LinkedIn home feed (author + post text).

offset.description: Explicit zero-based offset; maximum 1000. One provider page per call.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from the same tool, query and count. Do not combine with offset.

tools.name: get_notifications
tools.description: Get your recent LinkedIn notifications (headline, time, read state).

offset.description: Explicit zero-based offset; maximum 1000. One provider page per call.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from the same tool, query and count. Do not combine with offset.

tools.name: search_people
tools.description: Search LinkedIn people by keywords. Returns name, headline, location, and public identifier (pass that to get_profile for full details).

tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search LinkedIn jobs by keywords (and optional location). Returns title, location, posted time.

offset.description: Explicit zero-based offset; maximum 1000. One provider page per call.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from the same tool, query and count. Do not combine with offset.

location_geo_id.description: Optional LinkedIn geo URN id to scope the location

tools.name: get_inbox
tools.description: List a bounded first page of recent conversations with participant names, headlines and profile links. Continuation is not verified.

tools.name: get_job_details
tools.description: Get full details for a job posting by its numeric id (the digits in /jobs/view/<id> or from search_jobs jobUrn).

tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Search LinkedIn companies by keywords. Returns name + universalName slug (pass that to get_company for full details).

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Get a company by its LinkedIn URL slug (e.g. "google", "microsoft"). Returns name, description, website, industry, size, HQ.

tools.name: get_company_posts
tools.description: Get a company's recent posts by its LinkedIn URL slug (e.g. "google"). Returns post text + a short meta line.

tools.name: get_company_employees
tools.description: List employees LinkedIn surfaces for a company (by URL slug). Returns name, headline, and public identifier (feed the slug to get_profile). Prospecting core.

tools.name: get_pending_invitations
tools.description: List your pending connection invitations — received (inbound, with the urn/sharedSecret to accept later) and sent (outbound). Read-only.

tools.name: get_conversation
tools.description: Read a bounded page of messages by the conversation URN from get_inbox, sorted oldest-first with sender attribution when present. Continuation is not verified.

conversation_urn.description: Full urn:li:msg_conversation:(...) from a get_inbox result

tools.name: prepare_job_application
tools.description: Create a local, unsaved application worksheet with optional reusable evidence and resume/cover-letter drafts. Only explicitly selected, user-supplied evidence is used; nothing is fetched, filled, uploaded, submitted or stored. Verify every claim and the current listing yourself.

job_title.description: Title copied from the selected listing; not verified here

company.description: Optional company copied from the listing

requirement.description: One requirement copied or summarized by you

evidence.description: Your own truthful evidence; omit if unknown

evidence_ids.description: Up to 10 unique, case-sensitive IDs from your evidence_library

requirements.description: At most 20 requirements and your matching evidence

evidence_library.description: Up to 30 user-provided facts; only referenced facts are selected

id.description: Unique case-sensitive ID: 1–64 letters, digits, hyphens or underscores; first character alphanumeric

text.description: Exact user-provided evidence; not verified or interpreted

source_label.description: Optional user-provided label only; no file or URL is read or verified

include_drafts.description: Default false: include deterministic, unverified plain-text drafts only when true

tools.name: export_application_tracker
tools.description: Format up to 50 application statuses that you enter into a CSV. It does not inspect LinkedIn, infer submission, or save data. A receipt-verified status requires your explicit confirmation.

tools.name: connect_with_person
tools.description: [ALPHA, write] Send a connection request. Gated: requires confirm:true. Returns a structured status (ok | duplicate | already_connected | restricted | quota_exhausted | failed | unknown). Counts against the daily connect cap.

profile_id.description: The fsd_profile id (the ACoAA… part of the profile URN)

preview_token.description: Server-issued, five-minute preview token. Required for a new submission together with its operation_id. Not required for a journal lookup.

preview_hash.description: Hash returned by the reviewed preview. Rejects changed target/content before any browser action.

operation_id.description: Caller-generated unique ID (8-128 letters, digits, _ or -). Reuse the same ID and inputs to retrieve the stored outcome without resubmitting, including after a timeout. If omitted for a preview, the server generates one. New submissions require the preview operation ID.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Omit/false = refuse (safety).

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: [ALPHA, write] Send a message. Pass thread_id / conversation_urn to REPLY into an existing conversation; new threads require a separate experimental opt-in and lack current live success evidence. Gated: requires confirm:true. Returns a structured status. Counts against the daily message cap.

recipient_urn.description: Recipient member URN (urn:li:fsd_profile:ACoAA…). Required when starting a NEW thread.

thread_id.description: Existing thread id (2-…) or full msg_conversation urn to reply into (preferred over recipient_urn).

preview_token.description: Server-issued, five-minute preview token. Required for a new submission together with its operation_id. Not required for a journal lookup.

preview_hash.description: Hash returned by the reviewed preview. Rejects changed target/content before any browser action.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Omit/false = refuse (safety).
